title: 885 Belmont Avenue
meta: 2 bed · 1 bath · ~800 sq ft · West Philadelphia
description:
Sunny 2-bedroom, 1-bath with an open kitchen and living area that feels open and easy to live in. In-unit washer and dryer, full bath, bright rooms, a flexible extra space for an office, den, or guests—and a little private yard out back. Simple, comfortable, move-in ready.

Located on Belmont Avenue in Philadelphia's 19104 neighborhood, this multi-family rowhouse blends classic brick character with practical front-porch living. Ornamental brick detailing, an elevated covered porch with wrought-iron railings, and a compact exterior storage shed sit among attached townhomes on a traditional city block. Schedule a showing to see the space in person.
